mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand, proxied by HOUST, leads to elevated corporate earnings expectations and higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST growth exceeds +3%.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment, measured by PAYEMS, reduces labor market uncertainty and boosts investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS growth exceeding +10% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL inflation rate crosses above 2%, the S&P 500 anticipates a Fed rate hike within 60 days, producing a negative forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when inflation crosses above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side weakness that reduces growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when INDPRO declines by > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both demand (GDPC1) and labor (PAYEMS) series amplifies earnings momentum and increases the probability of positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies show positive momentum.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% triggers a risk-off reaction as investors anticipate tighter policy, producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative when UNRATE falls below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 expects slower growth and delivers negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative despite persistent high FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) over two months indicates supply chain disruptions, which reduces growth forecasts and results in negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns in a recession regime.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO recovers above 100 by the end of the window.
